backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profile storage, and blob file registration with admin/user permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a UI change on the Travel Style Quiz results screen to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend components and pages describing their functionality and behavior.
frontend/.gitignore: Gitignore file excluding dependencies, build outputs, environment files, IDE files, OS files, logs, and temporary files.
frontend/deploy-logs/.gitkeep: Placeholder file ensuring the deploy-logs directory is tracked in version control.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file bootstrapping the frontend app and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/scripts/deploy.ts: Deployment script orchestrating backend binding generation, frontend build, and canister deployment with retry and failure logging.
frontend/scripts/deploySteps.ts: Utility module executing individual deployment steps, capturing output, and detecting transient failures.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Brief documentation indicating that the scripts directory contains rerunnable deployment scripts.
frontend/scripts/redaction.ts: Redaction utilities that scrub sensitive data such as keys, tokens, PEM blocks, principals, emails, and credentialed URLs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component managing routing, authentication state, language context, and conditional rendering of all pages.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal for creating or editing blog posts, including image upload, form handling, and timezone conversions.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Displays blog posts and Instagram feed with tabs, video autoplay logic, and admin controls.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Read-only modal showing full blog post details, formatted content, metadata, and view count.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form with controlled inputs and submission logic plus static contact info.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with localized text, navigation links, and social media icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo loading, navigation, language selector, login, and admin/tool actions with periodic logo refresh.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Admin tool to preview, validate, and upload the hero image with size/type checks, status handling, and auto-hide behavior.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero image with responsive layouts and shows the admin uploader when permitted, polling for updates.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: CRUD interface for Instagram feed items supporting image/video uploads, previews, validation, and editing.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown to switch site languages with click‑outside closing and flag labels.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading state and automatic session clearing.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Admin interface for uploading and validating the site logo and refreshing it after successful upload.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: Manages editable packing list categories and items with default data and UI actions for adding, editing, and organizing items.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Renders a modal for creating a user profile with validation, language selection, and API submission.
frontend/src/components/QuizManager.tsx: Provides management UI and default data for geography and travel‑style quizzes, including questions and archetypes.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductManag: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting shop products, including image uploads and form validation.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductModal: Modal for adding or editing a shop product with image upload, validation, and product creation via API.
frontend/src/components/ShopSection.tsx: Displays a shop section with product list, admin add-product button, and product detail handling including image navigation and affiliate buy links.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Renders toast notifications from a manager with type-based styling, icons, and dismiss controls.
Shows a responsive grid of travel tools with icons and navigation handling for desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
frontend/src/components/TravelToolsSecti: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Provides an admin user management interface allowing role assignment, user info display, clipboard copying, and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Implements a language context with persistence, translation lookup, and a provider for multilingual UI strings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, identity persistence, state flags, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, and user management using an actor-based backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining fonts, colors, utility classes, animations, and Tailwind customizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page providing blog, user, media, settings, and tool management with multiple data fetches and modals.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post with images, metadata, view counting, sharing, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Paginated blog listing page showing posts, view counts, and navigation between pages.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Implements a geography quiz with flag and capital questions using an extensive country dataset and Instagram story generation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage by composing hero, blog, shop, and contact sections with optional blog click handling.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Provides an interactive packing list tool with predefined categories, selectable items, and support for custom items.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Displays a filterable and sortable list of shop products with product detail modals and affiliate link handling.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Compares mock train and flight options, showing prices, durations, and savings with randomized example data.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Runs a quiz to determine a user's travel archetype based on predefined personality types and questions.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: Defines a Trip Randomizer React page using mock flight, hotel, and destination data to generate random trip results with images and highlights.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Provides a canvas-based generator that creates Instagram Story images with customizable backgrounds, logos, and text.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Implements a toast manager for showing, removing, and subscribing to toast notifications.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, components, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Describes the project state and feature requests, including adding a packing list shortcut on the quiz results page.
